current.detail: No Lean installation is required. [Try the Bell example](../README.md#try-it).

current.state: Compatible exports, loading and diagnostics published in 0.2.5
current.detail: [Issue 160](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/160) and [regressions/validation](../tests/fixtures/review_followup_v024/README.md) cover short exact target phases, negative controls, QFT2/QFT3 export, clean workspace, opt-in declared qrate roots, metadata warnings, import/type/binding hints and manifest-derived corpus counts. Independent complex columns preserve phase/output axes and zero return; no general backend proof or Resource Safety certificate. [Issue 165](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/165) tracks phase-aware IR/cost design at 0.3.0. Existing borrowing, prelude, generic checking, synthesis and exact/approximate domain Issues carry the review experiments; published artifacts remain immutable.

current.state: Compatible refactoring published in 0.2.5; exact-source validation passes
current.detail: [Final publication validation](../tests/fixtures/releases/v0.2.5/publication.json): both local Rust toolchains pass 555 tests, Clippy/fmt; all eight hosted CI jobs and clean distribution/install checks pass. [Earlier development record](releases/v0.2.5.md) and [validation](../tests/fixtures/releases/v0.2.5/refactoring-validation.json) checkpoint: 545 all-target Rust tests on both 1.98.1 and 1.85.0, 132 byte-identical CLI comparisons, 96 independent source comparisons, 48 finite corpus cases, ten Python/QIR connection tests and small native hierarchy/Fourier/QPE checks pass. Existing public contracts, capacities and Rust authority remain unchanged. [Kernel continuation](../tests/fixtures/releases/v0.2.5/kernel-refactoring-validation.json) adds universal equality for seven conditional functions, 1,435 native transport comparisons, compiled public-type review, full Lean rebuilds/audits and component/host comparisons. Source identities are refreshed; checker/theorem contracts and disabled schemas remain unchanged. VM-25 acceptance/proof migration and publication are separate.

current.state: All current .qli/.qlt files explicitly use edition 2026
current.detail: [Edition contract](language-editions.md) and [Issue 96](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/96): manifests belong to corpus, stdlib, examples and test trees, with no repository-root manifest. The std qrate has a full schema-2 manifest; all other trees are to migrate to qrate management later. QLT execution remains deferred. The in-progress qargo captures std but its linked 0.2.1 local loader rejects basis.qli; the namespace adapter remains pending.

current.state: Compatible frontend and QFT repairs integrated in 0.2.3
current.detail: [Issue 102](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/102) and [validation](../tests/fixtures/review_v022/validation.json) record 530 passing all-target tests on Rust 1.98.1/1.85.0. Repairs cover the stdin race, capture diagnostics, commuting QFT schedules/root factoring, lowering preflight and corpus providers. The 4,000-case ownership comparison agrees; paired Rust/Python checking retains explicit scope differences. Native QFT widths 1–3 match. [QPE capacity repair](../tests/fixtures/qpe_capacity_v023/README.md) accepts both tested (1,3) schedules at 1,996,759 structural/708 exact units under the unchanged 2,000,000 cap. Final Rust/MSRV all-target checks pass 531 tests; 34 optional tests are explicit.

current.state: Manifest and sized frontend fixes published in 0.2.4
current.detail: [Issues 116–119](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/116) and [development validation](../tests/fixtures/issue_fixes_v024/validation.json) cover portable manifest symlink/non-file rejection, sized entry/provider visibility, execution-only --basis and the existing Linux procfs diagnostic. [Final publication validation](../tests/fixtures/releases/v0.2.4/publication.json) adds exact-commit Linux Rust/MSRV and native CLI checks; macOS passes 542 all-target tests, Linux 544.

[Full 0.2.5 validation](../corpus/validation-v0.2.5.json): 13,383 probes, four rejections, 30 detected type-correct faults. [New first sources and actual repair](../corpus/authoring/v025-small/README.md) cover CZ/Toffoli, inclusive/strict comparisons, mixed rotations and a two-wire mixer at 1–3 data qubits. Five first and all six repaired checks pass. Frozen inputs/VM-22 36-case/12-fault census and historical reports remain; no general algorithm/translation proof.

current.state: VM-22–25 implemented and checked for their declared profiles; VM-26–29 open
current.detail: [VM-25 completion](../tests/fixtures/verification_v025/completion/README.md) covers all eleven straight-line pure constructors, complete owners/effects, independent complex raw action, local finite equations and non-dense protected zero return on arbitrary correlated amplitudes. Fresh retained graphs bind complete signature/body/name/source attachments and published literal/expanded capacities. Direct original-use coefficient evaluation preserves auxiliary capacities without a combined-width matrix restriction. 146 completion cases, 31 Rust comparisons and 79 independent matrices pass alongside 121 original-body cases, 104 Rust comparisons, 85 rational matrices, 180 trace comparisons and six actual source prefixes. Semantic validation stays at three qubits; wide tests inspect metadata. VM-26 retains pure classical branches/observation, VM-27 hierarchy closure and VM-28/29 production integration. Rust stays authoritative; external schemas remain disabled.
